name: workerhelper
description: WorkerHelper: doc-driven AI coding workflow suite. Mandatory routing rule: for ANY coding task (add/modify/fix/refactor a feature, code question, bug, test failure, crash, regression), load the worker-lookup skill FIRST to locate code via the feature route map, then follow its routing (small change -> exec-plan; medium/large/unclear -> design -> plan -> exec-plan; bugs -> worker-debug). Run worker-sync after feature changes.

interface.shortDescription: Doc-driven AI coding workflow: locate code via route maps, route by task scale
interface.longDescription: WorkerHelper guides agent work through worker-lookup (code location via feature route map), design, plan, exec-plan, worker-debug, and worker-sync — scaling workflow depth by task size.
defaultPrompt: Help me find where this feature is implemented.
